_comment: Setup + PID configuration reference for this capture, added retrospectively (2026-06-26) for future reference. Pitch gains are quoted verbatim from pitch-oscillation-analysis.md ('applied (caused this)' table); roll/yaw are the concurrently-active rig tune (rig_tune.json / sysid_tune.json) and were not the focus. This is sysid pitch tune v1 (raw auto-design) — the UNSTABLE set that caused the cascade.
capture_type: armed flight capture of a pitch cascade limit cycle (stick centred)

hardware.airframe: X-quad. M1,M3 CW / M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned. A motor was already burned out earlier this session.

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default (flips s_mix_yaw only; default spin-sign was backwards -> yaw positive feedback). Roll/pitch mix unchanged. REQUIRED.

firmware.rate_controller_algo: PID cascade (RATE_CTRL_PID). INDI (firmware/src/control/rate_indi.c) did not exist until 2026-06-26 — it was NOT running here.
firmware.tune_applied: rig tune (roll sysid-tuned, yaw default+integral) + freshly-pushed sysid pitch v1; re-applied each boot via tools/sysid/apply_tune.py
firmware.note: FC does not persist tunes across power cycles.

pid._units: rate: controller=1, gains in (command)/(deg/s) family; angle: controller=0, kp in (deg/s)/deg.

roll.status: sysid-tuned roll (rig tune active; stable; not the focus)

pitch.status: sysid v1 raw design — fine on its own; verbatim from analysis 'applied' table

yaw.status: firmware default + integral (heading hold, stable with geometry fix)

pitch.status: sysid 0.25*wc (wc=16.57 rad/s) — TOO FAST; root cause of the 1.5 Hz cascade

identified_plant._comment: Pitch rate plant omega/u = K/(s(tau s + 1)), fitted from a 0.5->12 Hz chirp at ~0.25 throttle earlier this session; these gains are its loop-shaped output.

pitch.tau_note: derived from rate_kd/rate_kp = 0.00023/0.012; K stated in analysis

headline: angle_kp = 4.14 is too fast for the inner rate loop -> 1.50 Hz cascade limit cycle; pitch +/-~50 deg (102 deg pk-pk) with stick centred, pitch_out railed +/-1.0 for 19 % of samples. Rate gains are fine; the OUTER angle gain must come down. Fix: keep sysid rate gains, drop angle_kp to ~1.0-2.0 (and cap it in sysid_fit.design_gains -> ANGLE_KP_MAX=2.0).
